## Why

`Build Desktop` CI has been **red on every commit** (incl. `main`) while `Test` stayed green — caused by one Windows-only test failure: `runner::tests::prune_keeps_file_marked_active_before_it_exists` (`assertion failed: active_file.exists()`).

## Root cause (a real bug, not just a test issue)

`comparable_path_key` used `path.canonicalize()`, which is **existence-dependent**: it only resolves once the file is on disk, and on Windows also expands 8.3 short names / junctions. `prune_unused_files` records each round file's "active" key **before** the file is synced (canonicalize fails → raw path), then recomputes it while walking the cache **after** it exists (canonicalize succeeds → resolved path). The two keys diverge, the active file matches nothing in `active_paths`, and prune **deletes the file it just synced**. On the GitHub Windows runner the temp dir carries an 8.3 short name, so the keys differ there (but not on Linux, hence Test passing).

## Fix

Canonicalize only the longest **existing** ancestor and re-append the remaining components lexically (`canonicalize_existing_ancestor`), so the key is identical whether or not the leaf exists yet.

Added a **deterministic, cross-platform** regression test (`comparable_path_key_is_stable_across_file_existence`) using a `..` path that diverges under `canonicalize()` on any OS — verified it fails on the old code and passes on the new.

## Testing

- `cargo test -p shows-core`: 82/82 pass (was 81)
- Confirmed the new test fails on the pre-fix code (reverted the one-liner locally to check), passes after
- This should turn `Build Desktop` green
